en.title: Where Wealth Is Actually Safe: States, Law, Currencies and the Global Geography of Property
en.deck: A century-spanning comparative analysis of rule of law, economic security, foreign coercion, banks, sovereign debt, custody, houses, farmland, inheritance and the protection of wealth across jurisdictions.
en.regime: Fragmented world of legally enforceable property rights, institutionally divergent investment jurisdictions and increasing cross-border restrictions
en.key_risk: Mistaking broad institutional reputation for legal access, liquidity and protection of any specific financial, land or property claim
watch: WJP rule of law and independence of courts
Deposit insurance and bank resolution regimes
Rural land acquisition and title law for foreign owners
en.search_text: Global legal security economic security institutional rule of law where keep safe wealth finance deposits treasury securities bank safety offshore assets property houses farmland land ownership foreign investment countries 2026 comparative research

pt-BR.title: Onde o patrimônio realmente está seguro: Estados, leis, moedas e a geografia global da propriedade
pt-BR.deck: A segurança jurídica e econômica do patrimônio entre países: Estado de Direito, bancos, títulos, moedas, imóveis, fazendas, propriedade rural, interferência estrangeira, sucessão e cenários históricos e futuros.
pt-BR.regime: Sistema mundial de propriedades legalmente exigíveis, com proteção institucional desigual e riscos crescentes de restrições transfronteiriças
pt-BR.key_risk: Confundir reputação institucional geral com direito concreto de adquirir, manter, transferir e liquidar cada classe de ativo
watch: Estado de Direito WJP e independência judicial
Sanções e restrições de custódia financeira
Regras de garantia bancária e resolução
Terra rural e propriedade de estrangeiros
Sucessão, tributação e controles cambiais internacionais

producer_checks.research_depth: 15-part Portuguese manuscript, 90 numbered sections, approximately 15,750 words; English analytical counterpart with same 15-part and 90-section structure, approximately 13,700 words; 42 named institutional source references.
producer_checks.visual_evidence: Two matched quantitative institutional charts, one flow and one region-comparison map, plus multiple tables, equally present in PT-BR and EN.
producer_checks.fact_methodology: WJP 2026 judicial data independently rechecked, UK 2025 FSCS 120k, Australia residential ban to June 2029, EU immobilization of Russian reserves circa EUR210bn. Explicit distinctions between stock, claims, custody, legal right, currency, prices, sanctions and physical risk.
producer_checks.editorial_conformance: No narrative about building the site or report production. No 'best country' universal score. Legal eligibility is conditional on investor, country, property class, permits, residency and tax status.
producer_checks.comparison_scope: Europe, North America, Latin America, East Asia, South and Southeast Asia, Oceania, Gulf, Africa and war-affected jurisdictions.
producer_checks.limitations: This is a jurisdictional and historical comparative research study, not advice for a specific investor or asset purchase. National and state-level legal conditions can change, and financial guarantees are restricted by eligibility.

limitations: Jurisdictional rights differ by nationality, tax residence, status, type of property and date of purchase.
The WJP score is not a probability of patrimonial loss or sovereign-default rating.
Some bank guarantee, foreign-property and sanctions rules are evolving; official legal text should govern actual transactions.
Property value, creditworthiness, legal title, physical safety and liquidity are separate outcomes.
Country commentary includes conditional structural assessments rather than probability forecasts.
